# glTF source codecs

These source codecs are linked privately by the offline AssetImport program.

- cgltf v1.15, commit `360db1a95480fe102ae9c69b27c5d101167ff5ba`. The upstream `cgltf.h` is unmodified. [Source](https://github.com/jkuhlmann/cgltf/tree/360db1a95480fe102ae9c69b27c5d101167ff5ba) · [License](LICENSE.cgltf)
- LodePNG, commit `ed6fe5825c6a4fbb7f58ab35a4231c7543cd452a`. The upstream `lodepng.h` and `lodepng.cpp` are unmodified. The build uses the in-memory decoder with ancillary metadata disabled. [Source](https://github.com/lvandeve/lodepng/tree/ed6fe5825c6a4fbb7f58ab35a4231c7543cd452a) · [License](LICENSE.lodepng)
